name: cv-generator-video
description: Remotion compositions for CV Generator's YouTube video. A separate package so the render toolchain never enters the app's install or its build.

scripts.video:render: remotion render src/index.ts Film out/video-raw.mp4 --audio-bitrate=192k && node scripts/loudnorm.mjs out/video-raw.mp4 out/youtube/cv-generator.mp4 && rm out/video-raw.mp4
